look_here_first: FIRST measure the pedicel from its junction on the flowering branch to the calyx, using multiple flowers. Pedicels can be conspicuously long (reported to about 30 mm). Next compare the calyx lobes, which are very short relative to the tube. Do not decide from purple flower color or right-angle branching.
